overview_description.description: Xare is a fintech company that provides digital payment and money transfer services. The platform allows users to share access to their credit or debit cards securely and send money to family or friends across countries. Xare mainly focuses on helping people manage and share financial resources more easily through its app.

about_short_description.short_description: Xare is a revolutionary way for you to share access to your credit or debit cards with anyone, anywhere –securely, instantly

product.name: Xare Card
product.description: A virtual card linked to a user's credit or debit card that can be shared securely with others for instant spending without revealing card details.

product.name: Xare App
product.description: A mobile application that enables users to create, share, and manage virtual cards linked to their credit or debit cards for secure, instant money sharing and spending.

product.name: XareClub
product.description: A feature that allows users to form invite-only groups to share access to multiple credit cards among trusted members for collective benefits.

product.name: XARE Family Card
product.description: A virtual card service that allows users to share their credit or debit card access with family members worldwide with spending controls.

product.name: XARE Gift Card
product.description: A virtual gift card that users can send to others, allowing recipients to shop from multiple stores and access exclusive deals and offers.

product.name: XARE For Later
product.description: A buy now, pay later service that allows users to get credit, pay in installments, and share access with others worldwide.
